status_summary: The House intelligence committee passed its FY2026 intelligence authorization bill on 2025-09-10 (Breaking Defense), and Federal News Network reported that the bill would have the DNI establish an official to oversee open-source intelligence across the IC and minimize duplicative open-source activities and funding; industry groups urged the committees' leaders on 2025-10-24 to keep these measures, and the Senate version did not contain them (Washington Technology). Division F of Public Law 119-60 (signed 2025-12-18), the enacted FY2026 intelligence authorization, has no open-source section in its table of contents, and ODNI's August 2025 reorganization fact sheet does not mention open-source intelligence; no designation of the Principal Deputy DNI as chair of the National Open Source Committee was found. The House intelligence committee ordered the FY2027 authorization bill (H.R. 9624) reported, amended, by voice vote on 2026-07-20, and Federal News Network reported that it again contains open-source provisions on budget reporting and sharing across the IC; no reported text or floor action was listed as of the bill status read.
